cohort: 449 mother-neonate pairs enrolled in the Canadian Healthy Infant Longitudinal Development national birth-cohort study at two tertiary hospitals and one rural hospital in Manitoba, Canada
finding: Neonatal antibiotic exposure during the perinatal period was associated with maternal overweight, hypertension, emergency caesarean section, and unknown maternal GBS status.
mod_finding: Neonatal antibiotic treatment was highest following emergency caesarean section (12%)
